verses.inni-nu-itu-bihibbina-l-fa-hashimi-c1-v1: ʾinnī nuʿītu biḥḥibinā l-fā hāshimi niʿma l-mujāwiru bin-nabiyyī l-hāshimī
verses.inni-nu-itu-bihibbina-l-fa-hashimi-c1-v2: walaqad qaḍā rabbu l-warā biwafātihi nasashā bihijrati khayri khalqi r-rāḥimi
verses.inni-nu-itu-bihibbina-l-fa-hashimi-c1-v3: ṭābat ḥayātu mujāwiri wamuḥāwiri biriḍā l-ʿalī ʾakrim biʿayshi l-fāhimi
verses.inni-nu-itu-bihibbina-l-fa-hashimi-c1-v4: ʾarḍu l-madīnati qad bakathu biẓāhiri lakin libāṭinihā s-surūru liqādimi
verses.inni-nu-itu-bihibbina-l-fa-hashimi-c1-v5: niʿma l-wafiyyū l-murtaḍā bijīrihi ʾarḍu l-baqīʿi ḥawat birawḍaḍi ʿālimi
verses.inni-nu-itu-bihibbina-l-fa-hashimi-c1-v6: ʿilmu wajūdu wat-tuqā wasiyādatu ḥashwu ḍ-ḍarīḥi waḥikmahu bimakārimi
verses.inni-nu-itu-bihibbina-l-fa-hashimi-c1-v7: maʾawā ḍ-ḍuyūfi ʾidhā ʾatawhu ziyārata rawḍa r-rasūli waḥajja bayti l-ḥākim
verses.inni-nu-itu-bihibbina-l-fa-hashimi-c1-v8: huwa muḥsinu lijamīʿihim qad jāl fī subuli l-maḥāsini muḥsinā liʿawālimi
verses.inni-nu-itu-bihibbina-l-fa-hashimi-c1-v9: wallāhi mā ḍaḥikat ʾakhī dunyāhu min ʾukhrāhu qayda ḥayātihi bilawāzimi
verses.inni-nu-itu-bihibbina-l-fa-hashimi-c1-v1: fal-mawtu mujtāḥu l-warā likullinā minhu n-naṣību falā maḥīṣa lināʾimi
ghaddāratu hadhī d-dunā maʿ ʾannanā fī ghirrati fal-ʾamru ghayru mulāʾimi
ʾadʿūka yā rabbī bijāhi muḥammadi wabiḥurmahi sh-shaykhi t-tijānī s-sālimi
ʾan taḥshura l-ḥibba r-riḍā l-fūtī ṣ-ṣafī fī zumrati l-fayḍi l-ʾilahī l-khātimi
wakadhā l-jiwāru bisayyidī hādī l-warā waʾabī l-batūli shafīʿinā wal-qāsimi
suknāhu ʿilliyūna ʾaʿlāhā ḍamā natuhu thabbit yā ḥabbadhā min qāʾimi
waʿalā n-nabiyyī l-muṣṭafā wal-mujtabā ʾazkā ṣ-ṣalāti maʿa s-salāmi d-dāʾimi
wal-ʾāli wal-ʾaṣḥābi wal-fursāni man tuqḍā biḥurmatihim ḥawāʾiju rāʾimi
